title: A Family of Simultaneously Cospectral Trees for Degree-Distance Matrices
summary: Spectral characterization of graphs for various graph matrices constitutes a central topic in spectral graph theory. Let $G$ be a graph with adjacency matrix $A(G)$, diagonal degree matrix $\Deg(G)$, distance matrix $D(G)$, and transmission matrix \(\Trs(G)\), respectively. Recently, Alfaro and Zapata (2024) introduced the degree-distance matrices \(\Ddegp(G)=\Deg(G)+D(G)\) and \(\Ddeg(G)=\Deg(G)-D(G)\), together with the transmission-adjacency matrices \(\Atrsp(G)=\Trs(G)+A(G)\) and \(\Atrs(G)=\Trs(G)-A(G)\).
